text:
alex: Heads up — staging canary for embed-worker hit intermittent 500s after the kvcache migration. I built a hotfix image redwood/embed:2.3.1-hotfix and I want an expedited deploy to prod. @maria @sam please advise.

deploybot: Deploy request created by alex: service=embed-worker image=redwood/embed:2.3.1-hotfix targets=staging,canary,prod (canary wait required unless 2 approvals). Runbook: https://confluence.internal/release/2345

maria: Oncall — checking metrics now. Any sign of customer impact in prod?
alex: Only in staging/canary so far, but reproduces locally with the migration patch. Incident https://incident.internal/2345 shows spike. If we wait we risk a bigger window during the expected traffic burst in ~2h. Recommend expedited path with pinned image.
sam: We can greenlight expedited but need explicit rollback plan and release-note bullet. Is DB change reversible? maria?
maria: Rollback plan: revert traffic + redeploy redwood/embed:2.3.0, DB migration is additive and backwards-compatible. I'll be ready to cut traffic and execute rollback command. :white_check_mark:
alex: Release note draft: "Fix kvcache migration causing intermittent 500s on embedding requests. Fix: atomic cache init and nil-checks to avoid panics." Confluence: https://confluence.internal/release/2345/notes
deploybot: Approval gate: 2 approvers required to bypass canary wait. React with :thumbsup: or reply `approve <name>`. Approvals so far: 0/2.
lina: Product ok with expedited given customer risk, approve lina.
sam: approve sam
maria: approve maria
deploybot: Approvals recorded (2/2). Initiating canary deploy to embed-worker (image=redwood/embed:2.3.1-hotfix). Canary policy: 5% traffic, 5m smoke checks.
ops-bot: Canary smoke running. Sample checks: 200 OK rate, p95 latency, error rate <0.5% threshold.
ops-bot: Canary smoke passed after 5m. No regressions flagged. Proceeding to promote to prod in 2 minutes. :rocket:
alex: Promoting to prod now. Rollback trigger: errors >1% sustained for 3 minutes -> automatic traffic cut + redeploy to 2.3.0. maria, please monitor traces and logs.
maria: Monitoring now, pager on. Will cut traffic and run `kubectl rollout undo deployment/embed-worker --to-revision=2` if we hit the trigger. Also watching SLO dashboards. :eyes:
ops-bot: Prod rollout complete. Artifact: redwood/embed:2.3.1-hotfix. Post-deploy checks: OK. No alerting spikes.
alex: Thanks everyone — I'll publish the release note and update the incident once we hold stable for 30m. :pray:
